meta.source: EMA SES Table 3.5, 2018–2019, with NEA_HECS2017 as a prior on the AC share (this study)
meta.method: Bayesian grid posterior per dwelling row: ln coolFrac (prior = the table: two-piece normal through p10, value, p90) and ln s, one common factor on P_light, P_equip and E_other (prior N(0, 0.205²)); log-space Gaussian likelihood of the national EMA monthly values per household account 2018-01 to 2019-12 with σ integrated out and the effective sample size from the residuals' lag-1 autocorrelation; the model is the point model of js/model_sg.js over the OSM housing stock with the weather of each year, the billing kernel below and coolFrac scaled by HES AC ownership of the year. value = posterior median, p10/p90 = 10 % and 90 % quantiles of the marginal posterior. P_light, P_equip and E_other of a row move together (one factor), so their p10/p90 are not independent.

acSharePrior.source: NEA 2017 household energy consumption study (AC 24 % of household electricity, NEA press release 2018-05-05)
acSharePrior.note: a prior on each row's AC share added to the EMA likelihood (tools/sg/ema_fit.mjs --ac-share, default 0.24,0.2; none leaves it out)

meta.ownershipRule: coolFrac is stated at HES 2023 AC ownership, like the table; for another year multiply by households.byDwelling.<row>.acOwnershipByYear interpolated to that year ÷ the 2023 value
meta.merge: households.byDwelling.<row>.<param> (HDB rows hdb_1r2r, hdb_3r, hdb_4r, hdb_5r_ex) override the rows of data/archetypes_sg.json households.byDwelling, which assign() weights by the flat area of each block; types.condo and types.landed override those types' params. There is deliberately no types.hdb entry: it would replace the per-block weighting of the rows. The stock mean for blocks without units is in meta.hdbStockMean.

hdbStockMean.note: the calibrated HDB rows weighted by their national flat area in the OSM-matched stock (hdb_1r2r 5 %, hdb_3r 15 %, hdb_4r 42 %, hdb_5r_ex 38 %); for types.hdb.params (blocks without units) only

meta.notTest: Test results (2022–2024) are in qa/sg_ema_validation.json; nothing here was tuned on them.
